title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1972-10-19

ai_review.summary: A solid soundboard recording of the 1972 Fox Theatre show that delivers a mellow yet high‑energy set highlighted by a smoking The Other One, He's Gone and an epic NFA > Greatest Story > NFA finale.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is clear enough for most listeners, though a few note it could be crisper compared to other fall ’72 tapes. Musically the night shines with a superb The Other One/He's Gone sequence, an inspired Truckin’ > Drums > Other One jam, and a soaring NFA > Greatest Story > NFA closing stretch, all buoyed by strong contributions from Jerry, Keith and Bill.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews (plus one 5‑star) praise both the performance and the soundboard quality; weighting show strength (≈4.5) and recording adequacy (≈4) yields an overall rating around 4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear SBD, but several reviewers mention it lacks the crispness of other fall‑'72 tapes; no major dropouts or balance issues reported.

standout_songs: Not Fade Away > Greatest Story Ever Told > Not Fade Away
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly from a mellow opening into increasingly intense jams, culminating in a high‑energy NFA > Greatest Story > NFA sequence that drives the crowd to a fever pitch.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for immersive playing and strong presence (especially noted from front‑row perspective).
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's solo in The Other One highlighted as a rare, inspired moment; overall keyboard texture described as adding rich layers.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s rolling fills and tight accompaniment were repeatedly praised; the Drums segment within Truckin’ > Drums > Other One is singled out.
